'''''Jedi Apprentice: The Ties That Bind''''' by [[Jude Watson]] is the fourteenth in a series of young reader novels called '''''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'''''. All the books in the series are written by [[Jude Watson]], except for the first book, ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Rising Force]]'', which was written by [[Dave Wolverton]]. The series explores the adventures of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] prior to [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].
